comments: Topical outline of the Bodhicaryāvatāra (ID:3727), of which only an incomplete instance is extant (ID:6073). In view of the number of folios of the latter, this is a different text than the one by the same title instantiated in an (incomplete?) 17-folio manuscript - see (ID:7371).
name: byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i don bsdus
